title: LibreSwift
architecture: Decoupled iOS Swift compilation from macOS. Runs natively on Linux & WSL because paying Apple a hardware tax to compile code offended me.
impact: Direct USB device provisioning, rcodesign, and interactive LLDB debugging inside Linux VS Code.

title: a-Ha
architecture: Dopamine-neutral Android launcher for AuDHD brains. Text-only, zero icons, executive function scaffolding.
impact: Real-time 40Hz/14Hz binaural DSP synthesis, notification quarantine, instant recursive AI task breakdown. 4.3MB, 100% private.
stack: Kotlin, Android NDK, DSP, Audio Synthesis

title: circles
architecture: DPI-camouflaged, end-to-end encrypted group video & messaging engineered to defeat state-level Deep Packet Inspection.
impact: Zero-leak identity protocol that survives aggressive packet drops, hostile networks, and censorship.

title: aether
architecture: Zero-dependency PHP 8.3 persistent micro-framework. Vendor directories are a formal confession of cognitive failure.
impact: Sub-millisecond execution overhead via OPcache preloading and strict POSIX request lifecycles.

title: Imladris
architecture: Offline-first Android spatial Mind Palace engine. Biological working memory is volatile; external cognitive graph storage is permanent.
impact: Local SQLite vector graph, neural knowledge indexing, distraction-free spatial reading sanctuary.

title: thenet
architecture: Decentralized P2P mesh network for local Wi-Fi orchestration. Cloud dependency is architectural weakness.
impact: Decentralized local discovery, real-time WebSockets synchronization, peer-to-peer data transport.

title: Adaptive-Block-Sort
architecture: High-performance cache-conscious sorting algorithm combining block partitioning & adaptive in-place merging.
impact: Consistently outperforms QuickSort & TimSort on partially sorted memory arrays. Cache lines don't care about feelings.
